purpose: Which files go into each downloadable bundle, and the definitions and geography statements that travel with it. scripts/lib/coverage.js turns this into data/bundles/manifest.json (paths, sizes, hashes, version); the Data & methods page zips the files in the browser.

bundles.title: Crime: district and Delhi-wide registered cases
bundles.description: District crime releases 2016 to 2024 and the Delhi-wide printed totals 2011 to 2024, each with its manifest, plus the comparability rules.
bundles.geography: 15 police districts (earlier years under the districts reported that year; never re-allocated) and Delhi as a whole. Wards are not used: crime is published by district only.
definitions: A registered case is a First Information Report recorded by police, so it reflects reporting and registration as well as crime.
IPC became the BNS on 1 July 2024; the 2023 hurt head ('Hurt') and the 2024 head ('Hurt or Grievous Hurt') differ.
A null is unknown, unavailable or not separately reported; it is never zero.

bundles.title: Road safety: crashes, victims, zones and roads, 2004 to 2024
bundles.description: Citywide trend, deaths by mode of travel, enforcement, district tables, named crash-prone zones and road tables for every year held, each release with its manifest.
bundles.geography: Delhi as a whole, traffic districts as printed each year (11, 12 or 15; never mapped to today's 15 police districts), named locations and roads. Zone positions, where given (2023 and 2024), are hand-placed and approximate (150 m to 5 km).
definitions: Counts within crash-prone zones are crashes within that year's selected zones, not all crashes, and the zone lists change every year.
A fatal crash is a crash with at least one death; persons killed is a count of people.
Counts, not rates: no traffic or population denominator is published for these series.

bundles.title: Ward and district profiles, field-audit areas
bundles.description: Ward (290 legacy) and district profiles with the field contract, the recurring locations 2016 to 2024, the 2024 audit areas and the pedestrian corridors.
bundles.geography: 290 legacy wards (before the 2022 delimitation, not the current 250) and 15 police districts. Crime is district-level only; a ward carries its district's value, marked as inherited. Zone positions are hand-placed.
definitions: Every column's unit, source, data year and uncertainty class is in schema.json.
OpenStreetMap counts are lower bounds: a low count may mean little has been mapped.
An evidence tier says how strong the crash evidence is, not how dangerous a place is or what to build.
